folderless_lists.name: Carryover Register
folderless_lists.content: Capture surface for the Scaling People program. Not a work list. Anything that surfaces out of sequence lands here, from any chat, at any time. Routed items link to a target session task and are read before that session opens. This is where the tangent protocol and pause-and-resume write.

lists.name: Function → SaaS Map
lists.content: 100 business functions mapped to confirmed SaaS solutions. Each task contains use cases, strategic alignment, solution owner, integration type, AI opportunity, and launch phase. Primary working document for the Dominic tech review session. Filter by Solution to see any tool's full footprint. Filter by AI Opportunity = Yes for automation conversation list. Filter by Integration Type = TBD for the 7 open decisions.

lists.name: SaaS Catalog
lists.content: One task per confirmed or evaluated tool. Each task contains: category, primary function, functions handled (cross-referenced to Function → SaaS Map), native integrations, AI native capability, contract status, and launch phase. Use alongside Function → SaaS Map for the full picture.
